title: LIBERO-PeRM: Benchmarking Personalized Robotic Manipulation
summary: Personalization is essential for general-purpose robots to transition into household environments and achieve true practicality. While general robotic manipulation has been extensively studied, personalized robotic manipulation (PeRM) lacks a controlled benchmark for separating task completion from preference satisfaction. We introduce LIBERO-PeRM, a benchmark for preference learning in embodied agents. LIBERO-PeRM studies five questions: 1) how policies follow preferences in zero-shot settings; 2) how they learn single preferences from demonstrations; 3) how efficiently they acquire preferences as demonstrations increase; 4) how learned preferences generalize across layouts and tasks; and 5) how policies compose preferences and behave under conflicts. We propose a controlled formulation and taxonomy of observable preferences in simulation, covering motion, skill, and user-profile choices. This formulation is restricted to language-expressible preferences that can be instantiated in LIBERO without changing the task goal, evaluated automatically, and reused across tasks. Building on LIBERO, our procedural pipeline generates paired demonstrations with and without preferences. We create five task suites (312 tasks) with high-quality demonstrations, rich metadata, and preference-satisfaction metrics. Experiments show that current VLA policies struggle with zero-shot personalization, while SFT makes preferences learnable. Mixed training achieves better no-preference retention than sequential adaptation and improves performance with contextual prompts compared with preference-only training, but can weaken motion-preference learning; preference generalization, decomposition, and conflict handling remain difficult. The code, datasets, and demos can be found on the project website: https://libero-perm.github.io/.
comment: Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026); Project Website: https://libero-perm.github.io/

AI.tldr: 本文提出了LIBERO-PeRM基准，用于评估个性化机器人操作中的偏好学习，包含312个任务和丰富的偏好类型分类。
AI.motivation: 个性化机器人操作缺乏一个可控的基准来分离任务完成与偏好满足，而个性化对家用机器人的实用性至关重要。
AI.method: 提出了一个可控的可观测偏好分类法，涵盖运动、技能和用户档案选择，仅限于语言可表达的偏好；基于LIBERO构建了程序化流水线，生成带偏好和不带偏好的配对演示，创建五个任务套件（312个任务），配备高质量演示、丰富元数据和偏好满足度评估指标。
AI.result: 当前VLA策略在零样本个性化方面表现不佳，但SFT使偏好可学习；混合训练比顺序适应更好地保留无偏好能力，且通过上下文提示比仅偏好训练表现更好，但可能削弱运动偏好学习；偏好泛化、分解和冲突处理仍然困难。
AI.conclusion: LIBERO-PeRM为个性化机器人操作研究提供了标准化评估平台，揭示了当前方法在偏好学习上的局限性，特别是在泛化和冲突处理方面，为未来研究指明了方向。

title: OmniVerifier-C1: Decomposed Graded Verifier for Rule-Governed Generative World Modeling
summary: Generative visual verifiers play a crucial role in advancing multimodal intelligence. To enhance the robustness of visual verifiers in complex multimodal scenarios involving compositional requirements, we move beyond conventional binary verifiers that produce only True/False discrete judgments and introduce a verifier that automatically decomposes complex prompts or environmental rules into fine-grained components and assigns pointwise scores to provide a continuous and more informative critique signal. Our experiments further demonstrate that these structured and interpretable outputs improve the verifier's generalization to out-of-domain multimodal critic tasks. To train this verifier, we introduce a Decoupled RL training strategy that jointly optimizes sub-question-level binary judgment and global alignment scoring, using precise local feedback to develop fine-grained verification capabilities that provide a foundation for reliable continuous scoring at the global level. Under a general reinforcement learning framework, we first empirically demonstrate that the proposed pointwise graded verifier significantly outperforms binary verifiers in traditional text-to-image scenarios. We then extend our investigation to rule-governed generative world modeling where generative models are leveraged for world simulation and world reasoning under explicit rules. From a theoretical standpoint, we further show that a pairwise verification paradigm yields more accurate critiques than the pointwise formulation when ground-truth images are available, with empirical results on diverse structured world-modeling tasks such as Maze and Sudoku further validating the effectiveness of our approach. Overall, our findings suggest a key insight: the transition from generative models to structured world-modeling agents critically hinges on the availability of accurate pairwise graded visual verifiers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种将复杂提示分解为细粒度组件并逐点打分的生成式视觉验证器，通过解耦强化学习训练策略，显著提升了多模态场景下的验证能力。
AI.motivation: 传统二元视觉验证器仅输出True/False离散判断，在涉及组合需求的复杂多模态场景中鲁棒性不足，无法提供足够信息量的批评信号，因此需要更精细的连续评分机制来增强验证器的性能和泛化能力。
AI.method: 提出一种自动将复杂提示或环境规则分解为细粒度组件并逐点打分的验证器；采用解耦强化学习训练策略，联合优化子问题级别的二元判断和全局对齐评分，利用精确局部反馈建立细粒度验证能力，为全局连续评分提供基础；同时在理论上证明当真实图像可用时，成对验证范式比逐点公式产生更准确的批评。
AI.result: 在传统文本到图像场景中，所提出的逐点分级验证器显著优于二元验证器；结构化和可解释的输出提高了验证器在域外多模态批评任务上的泛化能力；在Maze和Sudoku等多样化结构化世界建模任务上的实验结果验证了方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 从生成模型向结构化世界建模智能体的转变关键依赖于准确成对分级视觉验证器的可用性；所提出的解耦RL训练策略和逐点评分机制为可靠的全局连续评分提供了基础，为多模态智能的发展提供了重要见解。

title: FDE-Gym: The Last Mile of AI Delivery
summary: Existing agent benchmarks typically evaluate agents on well-specified tasks defined by issue reports, specifications, or task tickets. Real-world customer delivery is different: forward-deployed engineers (FDEs) must clarify ambiguous requirements, work in live systems, and uncover unstated constraints. We introduce FDE-Gym, a benchmark of 95 end-to-end delivery tasks from 20 customer scenarios across 18 sectors, each adapted by industry experts from real-world delivery projects. In simulated customer environments with scripted stakeholders and modifiable customer systems, agents interact with stakeholders and operate on production-like systems to deliver working solutions. FDE-Gym scores a delivery by how much it improves the customer's own success metric, normalized between 0 (unchanged system) and 1 (reference solution), with penalties for stakeholder interactions (messages, trial runs, and waiting time). An online platform lets humans practice FDE skills under the same grading criteria. We evaluate 13 model configurations from seven providers. In the realistic setting, where unstated constraints must be discovered, the best configuration achieves a mean FDE-Gym score of 0.56 and resolves only 14 of the 95 tasks (a score of at least 0.8 with no incident). Discovering unstated constraints is the primary bottleneck: performance drops sharply when models must uncover them without explicit guidance. Yet information discovery alone does not account for the gap: even on the 23 tasks where the best configuration obtains every key fact from stakeholders, it reaches a normalized business uplift of 0.8 or above on only 10. These results reveal a substantial gap between solving well-specified tasks and delivering effective AI systems for real customers.
comment: 14 pages, 8 figures, 4 tables. Website: https://fde-gym.com/paper ; Code: https://github.com/deeplethe/fde-gym ; Data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/DeepLethe/FDE-Gym

AI.tldr: 本论文提出FDE-Gym基准，评估AI代理在真实客户交付任务上的能力，发现在需要发现未明确约束的现实场景中，最佳模型配置仅解决14/95个任务，揭示了从解决明确定义任务到真实客户交付之间的显著差距。
AI.motivation: 现有代理基准仅评估明确定义的任务（如issue报告、规格说明、任务单），而真实客户交付中，前向部署工程师（FDE）需澄清模糊需求、在实时系统中工作并发现未声明的约束。论文旨在弥合基准任务与真实交付之间的评估空白。
AI.method: 提出FDE-Gym基准，包含来自20个客户场景、跨18个行业的95个端到端交付任务，均由行业专家基于真实交付项目改编。在模拟客户环境中，代理与脚本化利益相关者交互，并在类生产系统上操作以交付可用方案。评分基于客户自身成功指标的改进，归一化至0（系统未变）至1（参考方案），并对利益相关者交互（消息、试运行、等待时间）施加惩罚。还提供在线平台供人类在相同评分标准下练习FDE技能。
AI.result: 评估了7个提供商的13种模型配置。在需发现未声明约束的现实场景中，最佳配置平均FDE-Gym得分仅0.56，仅解决14/95个任务（得分≥0.8且无事故）。发现未声明约束是主要瓶颈，模型须在无明确引导下发现这些约束时性能急剧下降。然而信息发现不足以解释全部差距：在最佳配置从利益相关者处获取所有关键事实的23个任务中，仅在10个上达到0.8以上的归一化业务提升。
AI.conclusion: 在解决明确指定的任务与为客户交付有效AI系统之间存在显著差距。仅信息发现不足以解释这一差距——即使拥有所有关键事实，代理仍难以交付有效解决方案。未来需关注真实交付场景中的综合能力提升，包括约束发现与方案实施。

title: MLExpert: Towards a Generalist Agentic Model for Autonomous Machine Learning Engineering
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are expanding from assisting scientific research and engineering to autonomously developing and improving AI systems, advancing AI for AI (AI4AI) as a pathway toward recursive self-improvement (RSI). Workflow-driven machine learning engineering (MLE) systems provide a practical path toward this pursuit through complex orchestration that manages long-horizon experimentation, while recent MLE systems adopt model-directed interaction, allowing models to autonomously organize experiments and adapt optimization strategies based on execution feedback. However, feedback from each experiment reflects several preceding decisions, and a long MLE run contains many such costly experiments. Training must therefore select useful supervision from long interaction trajectories and learn from intermediate outcomes. We propose a post-training method for autonomous long-horizon MLE optimization and apply it to train MLExpert, a 35B Mixture-of-Experts agentic model. We design the Kaggle-MLE Factory to construct executable tasks and an interaction harness for model-directed experimentation. Hierarchical agentic SFT transfers general tool-use and coding capabilities to MLE through outcome-guided supervision. Windowed Interaction RL (WIRL) treats the multi-turn decisions between successive experiment results as an execution window and assigns it a shared outcome-based reward. Asynchronous collection and policy correction support policy updates before the trajectory ends. On MLE-Bench Lite, MLExpert improves the average medal rate of the base model from 37.9% to 72.7%, achieving performance comparable to larger frontier models such as Kimi-K3 and GLM-5.3. Further experiments show that MLExpert improves performance on NatureBench Lite, agent scaffold optimization, and algorithm optimization, suggesting that the learned optimization capability generalizes to other tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于自主长周期机器学习工程优化的后训练方法，并训练了MLExpert模型，在MLE-Bench Lite上将基础模型的平均奖牌率从37.9%提升至72.7%。
AI.motivation: 现有的MLE系统在长期实验中面临反馈延迟和实验成本高的问题，需要从长交互轨迹中选择有用的监督信号并从中间结果中学习，以实现自主的长周期MLE优化。
AI.method: 提出了分层智能体SFT（通过结果引导的监督将通用工具使用和编码能力转移到MLE）和窗口化交互强化学习WIRL（将连续实验结果之间的多轮决策视为执行窗口并分配共享的基于结果的奖励），同时设计了Kaggle-MLE Factory来构建可执行任务和交互框架，并使用异步收集和策略纠错支持在轨迹结束前进行策略更新。
AI.result: MLExpert在MLE-Bench Lite上将基础模型的平均奖牌率从37.9%提升至72.7%，达到与Kimi-K3和GLM-5.3等更大前沿模型相当的性能；在NatureBench Lite、智能体框架优化和算法优化等任务上也表现出性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过WIRL和分层SFT训练的MLExpert不仅显著提升了MLE任务性能，其学习到的优化能力还能泛化到其他任务，为AI4AI和递归自我改进提供了实践路径。

title: 3DCodeVerse: Exploring 3D Worlds as Code
summary: We introduce 3DCodeVerse, a research ecosystem that enables coding agents to create editable and verifiable 3D content at scale. 3DCodeVerse comprises large-scale, high-quality datasets of executable 3D code, a coding harness for spatial reasoning and automated verification, and practical guidance for 3D coding. First, we construct 3DCodeVerse-2M, a large-scale curated dataset of standalone 3D executable code. We build this corpus by collecting open-source data, converting specialized representations, and generating new programs with coding agents. Each program is packaged with the source files and associated assets required for execution in its declared environment, along with available descriptions and verification records. Second, we develop the 3DCodeVerse Harness, a multi-agent directed acyclic graph framework for generating and refining 3D content. It uses execution checks, spatial measurements, and visual feedback to automatically evaluate and revise generated programs without human feedback during generation. Third, we conduct systematic empirical studies of 3D coding, establishing baselines with fine-tuned open models and deriving practical guidance through component-level analyses of our harness. Extensive experiments demonstrate that fine-tuning on our dataset significantly improves the 3D coding capabilities of open-source models. Notably, our 3DCodeVerse harness achieves a 90% win rate against Claude Design (3D Object) in pairwise human evaluations, when both are utilized by Claude Opus 5.5.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了3DCodeVerse研究生态系统，使编程代理能够大规模创建可编辑和可验证的3D内容。
AI.motivation: 旨在解决编程代理大规模创建可编辑且可验证的3D内容的难题，克服现有方法缺乏高质量数据集和自动化验证框架的局限。
AI.method: 构建了包含200万条可执行3D代码的数据集3DCodeVerse-2M，并开发了多智能体有向无环图框架3DCodeVerse Harness，利用执行检查、空间测量和视觉反馈实现无需人工反馈的自动评估与程序修订。
AI.result: 实验表明，在该数据集上微调显著提升了开源模型的3D编程能力；在配对人类评估中，3DCodeVerse harness（由Claude Opus 5.5驱动）对Claude Design (3D Object)取得了90%的胜率。
AI.conclusion: 3DCodeVerse通过提供大规模高质量数据集和有效的自动化生成验证框架，显著提升了3D编程能力，为未来的3D内容生成研究奠定了基础。

title: How Do Emotions Spread And Affect Decision-Making In Social Networks? An Opinion Dynamics Perspective
summary: Emotions affect how we think and perceive information. Motivated by this, we present a novel framework for modeling emotions, and study its impact in social networks. We represent emotions on a circle by utilizing the circumplex model. These emotions spread in a group through the process of emotional contagion, and influence the interpersonal relationships therein. We propose a model to explain the process of emotional contagion, and its effect on the decision-making process, using a Laplacian-based flow. Our key finding in this direction shows that agents with similar emotions reach agreement eventually, exhibiting emotional contagion. Through this, the widely observed behaviors of consensus, polarization, and clustering of opinions follow in complex-weighted networks. Our approach relies on the equitable partitions and spectral properties of Laplacians in complex-weighted networks. Lastly, we validate our findings using synthetic and real-world datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于复数加权网络的框架，用于模拟社交网络中的情绪传染及其对决策过程的影响。
AI.motivation: 情绪会影响人们的思维和信息感知方式，因此有必要研究情绪在社交网络群体中如何传播并影响人际关系和决策。
AI.method: 利用环状模型将情绪表示在圆上，提出基于拉普拉斯流的情绪传染模型，并结合复数加权网络的等分性质和拉普拉斯算子的谱性质进行分析。
AI.result: 研究表明，具有相似情绪的智能体最终会达成共识并表现出情绪传染；由此可推导出复杂加权网络中广泛存在的共识、极化和观点聚类行为。合成和真实数据集验证了这些发现。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的模型为社交网络中情绪传染导致的共识、极化和聚类现象提供了数学理论解释，并通过实验数据得到了有效验证。

title: KnowGPO: Knowledge-Grouped Policy Optimization for Search Agents
summary: Deep search agents solve knowledge-intensive tasks through long-horizon, multi-turn interactions, where assigning credit to individual search decisions is fundamentally difficult. Outcome-based reinforcement learning provides only a single terminal reward shared across an entire trajectory. Recent process-supervision methods aim to assign credit at finer granularity, but they typically anchor credit to either surface-level trajectory states or model-internal signals, both of which become unreliable in deep search where observations are heterogeneous and retrieved contexts are long and noisy. We propose KnowGPO, a reinforcement learning framework that aligns trajectories by the task-relevant knowledge they have acquired rather than by their surface observations. For each query, KnowGPO decomposes the information required to derive the answer into atomic knowledge conditions, and represents the state of a trajectory at each step by the subset of conditions it has satisfied. Trajectories sharing the same knowledge state are grouped for within-group comparison, and the incremental knowledge gain between consecutive steps serves as an environment-grounded process reward. Experiments on Xbench, BrowseComp-ZH, and GAIA show KnowGPO consistently outperforms outcome-only (GRPO) and process-supervision baselines (GiGPO, IGPO) by 3.8 to 4.2 points, with our 8B model rivaling or exceeding most 32B open-source systems.

AI.tldr: 提出KnowGPO强化学习框架，通过任务相关知识的获取状态而非表面观察来为深度搜索代理进行细粒度信用分配。
AI.motivation: 深度搜索代理在长时域多轮交互中，对单个搜索决策的信用分配本质上很困难。基于结果的强化学习只提供终端奖励，而现有过程监督方法依赖表面轨迹状态或模型内部信号，在深度搜索中因观察异构性和检索上下文冗长噪声而不可靠。
AI.method: KnowGPO将答案所需信息分解为原子知识条件，用已满足的条件子集表示每步的轨迹知识状态；将相同知识状态的轨迹分组进行组内比较，连续步骤间的知识增量作为环境基础的过程奖励，从而实现基于知识的轨迹对齐与信用分配。
AI.result: 在Xbench、BrowseComp-ZH和GAIA基准上，KnowGPO一致性地比仅基于结果的GRPO和过程监督基线（GiGPO、IGPO）高出3.8至4.2分，8B模型可媲美或超越大多数32B开源系统。
AI.conclusion: 基于知识状态的信用分配机制比基于表面观察或模型内部信号的方法更可靠，能有效提升深度搜索代理性能，且小模型也能达到大模型水平的竞争力。

title: Training Reasoning Models to Generate Diverse Scientific Ideas
summary: One of the first steps of a research pipeline is generating ideas. Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used to automate this step, but most of this work optimizes the quality of individual ideas, while overlooking diversity. In our work, we study document-grounded ideation, focusing on increasing the diversity of LLM generated ideas and ensuring they are high quality. Given prior papers, a model must propose a set of ideas that are each high-quality and clearly distinct from one another, while also being grounded in the input documents. To optimize for this, we propose training with a set-level reinforcement learning objective. In our setup, in a single generation, the model writes K structured idea cards grounded in the source papers, and the set is scored jointly, where each idea's quality is weighted by its distance from the ideas written before it. This teaches the model to steer each new idea away from its predecessors. We show that our trained 8B model achieves higher creative utility (a measure combining quality and diversity) than Claude Opus 4.8 and GPT-6 Astra on our contamination-free benchmark. In a pilot human study with four experts, our sets are judged as promising as Claude Opus 4.8's and contain marginally more unique ideas. When a coding agent runs proof-of-concept experiments on the ideas, our model's success@k is comparable to Claude Opus 4.8's, so we see that the added diversity does not cost any executability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出使用集合级强化学习目标训练LLM，以在文档驱动的创意生成任务中同时提升生成想法的质量与多样性。
AI.motivation: 当前利用LLM自动生成研究想法的工作主要优化单个想法的质量，却忽略了想法集的多样性，导致生成内容同质化。本文旨在解决如何让模型生成既高质量又彼此明显区分、且扎根于输入文档的想法集合这一问题。
AI.method: 提出集合级强化学习训练方法。模型在单次生成中基于源论文产出K张结构化创意卡片，整个集合被联合评分——每个想法的质量以其与先前生成想法的距离作为权重，从而引导模型主动规避已有想法、提升集合多样性。
AI.result: 训练得到的8B模型在无污染基准上的创意效用（质量与多样性综合指标）超过Claude Opus 4.8和GPT-6 Astra；在四位专家参与的初步人类研究中，其想法集合与Claude Opus 4.8同样有前景，且独特想法数量略多；编码代理执行概念验证实验时，该模型的success@k与Claude Opus 4.8相当，表明增加多样性并未损失可执行性。
AI.conclusion: 集合级强化学习能有效提升LLM生成想法的多样性与质量，且不牺牲可执行性。未来可进一步扩展该方法至更多创意生成场景，并探索更大规模模型的表现。

title: Mem4Act: Learning Effective Latent Memory for Long-Horizon Robotic Manipulation
summary: Long-horizon robotic manipulation fundamentally requires memory: agents must retain task-relevant information from past observations and interactions and use it to guide future actions. Existing approaches typically preserve raw historical observations, compressed visual tokens, or language summaries, but these representations either expose the action policy to increasingly long histories or risk discarding task-relevant temporal, semantic, and perceptual information. We introduce Mem4Act, a framework for learning effective latent memory as a fixed-size representation explicitly optimized for long-horizon robotic control. Mem4Act addresses three coupled challenges: how to efficiently cover long histories, what information memory should retain, and how to ensure the policy actually relies on memory. To this end, it organizes history via multi-granularity temporal aggregation, preserves complementary semantic and perceptual information through question-answering supervision and key-frame DINO feature reconstruction, and employs memory-first two-stage training to encourage greater use of memory by the action policy. The resulting memory captures both high-level task state and fine-grained perceptual evidence while providing a bounded interface to the action policy. Across RoboMME, RMBench, and four real-world manipulation tasks, Mem4Act achieves state-of-the-art performance on memory-dependent control, with success rates of 49.88%, 61.0%, and 81.5%, respectively. Extensive ablations further demonstrate the importance of temporal aggregation, complementary memory supervision, and memory-first training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Mem4Act框架，通过学习固定大小的潜在记忆表示来解决长程机器人操作中的记忆保留与利用问题。
AI.motivation: 长程机器人操作需要记忆，但现有的保留原始历史、压缩视觉标记或语言摘要的方法，要么让动作策略面临过长的历史序列，要么容易丢失任务相关的时间、语义和感知信息。

title: Learning Self-Orchestration in Decentralized Agent Swarms
summary: The capabilities of an agent swarm depend on both its individual members and how they coordinate. Yet existing multi-agent systems often train agents within fixed orchestration structures, separating the learning of individual capabilities from the organization of collective behavior. We introduce market-based post-training (MPT), a framework for jointly learning action policies and self-orchestration in decentralized agent swarms. Agents express their willingness to participate through bids, which determine who acts and how collective outcomes provide local training credit. Learning both action and bidding behavior allows individual capabilities and patterns of participation to adapt together without a central coordinating agent. We evaluate MPT on embodied crafting, robot navigation, and deep research. Results show gains over monolithic post-training and confirm that agent participation indeed evolves with learning. With the same post-trained action policies, learned self-orchestration outperforms alternative coordination strategies. Ablations show that both action and bidding benefit from learning, and that learned bids provide more effective action-training signals. Beyond the original training objectives, trained swarms adapt faster to related tasks and achieve better performance with larger populations at inference time. Larger populations also suffer smaller performance losses under agent dropout, demonstrating that learned self-orchestration supports reuse, scaling, and robustness in decentralized agent swarms. Code and trained models are available at https://github.com/Embodied-Minds-Lab/MPT.

AI.tldr: 本文提出市场式后训练框架(MPT),通过联合学习动作策略和自编排机制,实现去中心化智能体群体的协同优化。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体系统通常在固定编排结构下训练智能体,将个体能力学习与集体行为组织分离,限制了群体能力的整体提升,因此需要一种能联合学习个体能力和协作模式的框架。
AI.method: MPT框架通过竞价机制实现去中心化编排:智能体通过出价表达参与意愿,出价决定谁来行动以及集体结果如何提供局部训练信用,动作行为和竞价行为共同适应,无需中央协调智能体。
AI.result: 在具身制造、机器人导航和深度研究任务上,MPT优于单体后训练方法;相同动作策略下,学习的自编排优于其他协调策略;消融实验表明动作和竞价均受益于学习,且学习的竞价提供更有效的动作训练信号;训练群体在相关任务上适应更快,更大群体在推理时性能更好,且在智能体dropout下性能损失更小。
AI.conclusion: 学习的自编排机制支持去中心化智能体群体的复用、扩展和鲁棒性,为多智能体系统的联合优化提供了新范式,代码和模型已开源。

title: Energy Consumption Analysis of Discrete Diffusion and Autoregressive Language Models
summary: As Large Language Models (LLMs) continue to scale, their energy consumption during inference has become a critical concern. While Autoregressive (AR) models are the industry standard, Diffusion Language Models (DLLMs) have emerged as a promising alternative capable of parallel token generation. In this paper, we perform a comparative energy benchmark of diffusion models (LLaDA-8B, Dream-7B) against AR counterparts (Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen-2.5-7B). We analyze the trade-offs between model architecture, KV-cache optimization, and Joules-per-token efficiency. Our results show that at longer sequences (200--600 tokens), diffusion models achieve 2.5--2.7 J/token, approximately 2$\times$ more efficient than AR models with KV-cache (5.3--5.7 J/token). KV-cache provides substantial benefits for AR models at longer sequences (50--70\% energy reduction).

AI.tldr: 本文对比了扩散语言模型与自回归模型在推理时的能效，发现扩散模型在长序列生成中能效约为AR模型的两倍。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型规模扩大，其推理过程的能耗成为关键问题。本文旨在探究扩散语言模型是否比标准的自回归模型更节能。
AI.method: 对扩散模型（LLaDA-8B, Dream-7B）与自回归模型（Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen-2.5-7B）进行能效基准对比，分析模型架构、KV缓存优化与每Token能耗之间的权衡关系。
AI.result: 在较长序列（200-600个Token）下，扩散模型能耗为2.5-2.7 J/token，比带有KV缓存的自回归模型（5.3-5.7 J/token）效率高约两倍。此外，KV缓存为自回归模型在长序列中减少了50-70%的能耗。
AI.conclusion: 扩散语言模型在长序列推理任务中展现出显著的能效优势，是解决大语言模型推理能耗问题的有前景方向；而KV缓存优化对自回归模型的能效提升依然至关重要。

title: ForkGRPO: Efficient Exploration and Fine-Grained Credit Assignment for Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) have advanced rapidly, yet strengthening their reasoning through reinforcement learning (RL) remains an open challenge. Any-order generation can suffer from entropy degradation, which narrows the reasoning paths available for exploration. Recent work mitigates this issue by applying standard GRPO with left-to-right generation. However, independently generating every rollout from the input prompt can leave alternative continuations from intermediate states underexplored, while trajectory-level advantages assign uniform credit to all tokens without distinguishing the contributions of individual reasoning segments. We propose ForkGRPO, an RL framework that couples efficient exploration with fine-grained segment-level credit assignment. It samples multiple continuations from high-entropy intermediate states along a reference trajectory, prioritizing textual boundaries and reusing shared prefixes. The continuations provide complementary learning signals: within-state group-relative advantages guide which continuations to reinforce, while Monte Carlo state-value differences indicate which reasoning segments improve expected outcomes. Among the evaluated architecture-preserving RL methods, ForkGRPO achieves the best performance on three of four benchmarks, while improving over the directly comparable JustGRPO by up to 1.2 percentage points and using up to 27.8% fewer generated tokens. ForkGRPO-Fast further achieves a $2.49\times$ training wall-clock speedup with negligible accuracy loss.

title: Outcome-Routed Distillation and Reinforcement Learning for Diffusion Language Models
summary:
On-policy distillation provides dense supervision on the student's own samples, but its targets still come from the teacher. Verifier reinforcement learning (RL) instead uses an outcome signal, but it provides no direct constraint on capabilities outside the verifier. Combining the two is difficult for diffusion language models (dLLMs), because bidirectional denoising makes the policy likelihoods required by ratio-based RL unreliable.
  We develop a likelihood-free pipeline for a mixture-of-experts dLLM. Each rollout group is routed by verifier outcome. Mixed groups use ratio-free, group-centred REINFORCE. If every student rollout fails but a teacher succeeds, the model receives dense KL supervision on the student's denoising canvases. All other groups are skipped. A KL term anchored to the distilled checkpoint limits changes outside the verifier reward.
  The tool-calling teacher succeeds on only 18.6% of the training prompts. At 24 denoising steps, distillation exceeds the teacher by 6.77 percentage points, and routing improves the distilled checkpoint by a further 18.31 points. Routing lowers reasoning-trace accuracy by 0.71 points but raises direct-answer accuracy on the same items by 13.21 points. The anchored arm restores trace accuracy. Its tool-calling score differs by -0.16 points, with a confidence interval that includes zero, although this comparison also removes a small fallback distillation route. A domain-conditional recipe retains a 16.37-point tool-calling gain; a second seed gives 18.23 points and reproduces both preservation results, but the math result is seed-dependent. We pre-registered every arm and evaluated each comparison on paired items in a single sweep on one machine.

title: TRACESTEER: Trace Driven Activation Steering for Hallucination Mitigation in Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) have emerged as a promising alternative to autoregressive LLMs, yet remain susceptible to hallucination. Activation steering offers a promising mitigation approach by guiding parallel token predictions through internal representations. However, existing steering methods largely overlook two characteristics of dLLMs: dynamic denoising states and temporal hallucination risks, which challenge predefined steering vectors and uniform intervention strengths. We propose TRACESTEER, a trace-driven activation steering framework that uses preceding denoising predictions as feedback to jointly adapt steering direction and strength. Specifically, Denoising Feedback Steering (DF-Steering) constructs step-specific steering vectors from preceding predictions and current hidden states. Trajectory-Guided Steering Gate (TS-Gate) regulates their strength using prediction uncertainty and the denoising timestep. With the backbone frozen, factual supervision and magnitude regularization jointly guide the learning of adaptive steering interventions, promoting factual reliability and stability throughout denoising. Experiments on two dLLMs show improved factual reliability on TruthfulQA and generalization across five downstream benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于轨迹的激活引导框架TRACESTEER，通过自适应调整去噪过程中的引导方向和强度，有效缓解了扩散大语言模型的幻觉问题。
AI.motivation: 扩散大语言模型容易产生幻觉，而现有的激活引导方法忽略了其动态去噪状态和时间幻觉风险的特征，预定义的引导向量和统一干预强度难以适用。
AI.method: 提出TRACESTEER框架，包含去噪反馈引导（DF-Steering）和轨迹引导引导门（TS-Gate）。前者根据先前预测和当前隐藏状态构建特定步骤的引导向量，后者利用预测不确定性和去噪时间步长调节强度。模型主干冻结，通过事实监督和幅度正则化学习自适应引导干预。
AI.result: 在两个扩散大语言模型上的实验表明，该方法在TruthfulQA上提高了事实可靠性，并在五个下游基准测试中实现了泛化。
AI.conclusion: TRACESTEER通过考虑扩散模型的动态去噪状态，实现了自适应的激活引导，有效提升了事实可靠性和稳定性，为扩散大语言模型的幻觉缓解提供了新的有效方向。

title: HaloBlock: Faster and Better Decoding for Diffusion Large Language Models
summary: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) have attracted increasing research attention due to their bidirectional attention and arbitrary order decoding. However, there are two issues in dLLMs inference: the decoding difficulty is dominated by the tokens on the right side of the block, and the block-wise decoding inherently suffers from boundary contextual discontinuity. To tackle these limitations, we propose HaloBlock, a difficulty-aware adaptive halo mechanism for dLLM inference. We first leverage bidirectional cumulative entropy to characterize block decoding difficulty. Then, based on the bidirectional decoding difficulty, we adaptively allocate bidirectional halo regions on both sides of each block to mitigate boundary contextual discontinuity. The difficulty-aware design of HaloBlock smooths cross-block context propagation and lowers decoding difficulty for hard tokens, yielding better generation quality and faster convergence. Evaluated on LLaDA-8B-Instruct, Dream-7B-Instruct and LLaDA-1.5 across mathematical reasoning and code generation benchmarks, HaloBlock demonstrates consistent accuracy improvements and higher inference efficiency. Source codes are publicly available at https://github.com/PolyU-VCLab/HaloBlock.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HaloBlock机制，通过难度感知的自适应光晕区域分配来解决扩散语言模型中的块解码难度和边界上下文不连续问题。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型的分块解码存在解码难度受块右侧token主导，以及边界上下文不连续的问题，本文旨在解决这些推理限制。
AI.method: 提出HaloBlock，利用双向累积熵表征块解码难度，并据此自适应地在块两侧分配双向光晕区域，以缓解边界上下文不连续性并平滑跨块上下文传播。
AI.result: 在LLaDA-8B-Instruct、Dream-7B-Instruct和LLaDA-1.5上的数学推理和代码生成基准测试表明，HaloBlock提升了准确性并提高了推理效率。
AI.conclusion: HaloBlock的难度感知设计平滑了跨块上下文传播，降低了难解码token的难度，从而提高了生成质量并加快了收敛速度。

title: Batch-Paced: Fixed-Budget Batch Decoding in Discrete Diffusion Language Models
summary: As generative language models become more capable and widely used, inference demand grows, making efficient serving increasingly important. Discrete diffusion language models (dLLMs) offer a promising path to more efficient inference through parallel token generation. Prior dLLM decoding methods, however, focus on improving inference efficiency for individual sequences. We formulate fixed-budget dLLM batch decoding and introduce Batch-Paced, a training-free method that jointly optimizes the allocation of decoding compute across requests to improve overall batch quality. Across two dLLM backbones, five benchmarks and their representative mixtures, Batch-Paced improves batch performance under matched budgets; gains generally grow with batch size and largely persist across decoding configurations. Analysis of requests' decoding trajectories suggests that these gains arise largely by raising the committed-token confidence of lower-confidence requests. We further show that Batch-Paced's batch decode time remains competitive and that adding a decoding-depth allowance during Batch-Paced decoding can shorten it further at a modest performance cost.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种免训练的批次解码方法Batch-Paced，通过联合优化跨请求的解码计算分配，在固定预算下提升了离散扩散语言模型的整体批次质量。
AI.motivation: 随着生成式语言模型推理需求的增长，现有的离散扩散语言模型解码方法仅关注单序列的推理效率，缺乏在固定计算预算下优化整个批次解码资源分配的机制。
AI.method: 提出了固定预算的dLLM批次解码公式，并引入免训练的Batch-Paced方法，通过联合优化跨请求的解码计算分配来提升整体批次质量。
AI.result: 在两种dLLM骨干网络和五个基准测试中，Batch-Paced在匹配预算下显著提升了批次性能，且增益随批次大小增加而扩大。轨迹分析表明，这些增益主要源于提高了低置信度请求的已提交token置信度。此外，其解码时间保持竞争力，增加解码深度余量可进一步缩短时间。
AI.conclusion: Batch-Paced有效解决了固定预算下dLLM批次解码的计算分配问题，通过优化资源调度提升了整体服务质量和效率。

title: Prefilling-dLLM v2: Learned Chunk Routing for Long-Context Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion language models apply bidirectional attention over the whole context at every denoising step, so a longer context makes each step substantially more expensive. Sparsifying only at inference leaves the pretrained weights unchanged, so the model is never trained under the sparse pattern it runs with. We propose Prefilling-dLLM v2, which continues training a diffusion language model so that it routes with its native mask token. One mask is appended at the end of each chunk, and a learned role offset marks it as a routing slot. On every fourth layer, a query keeps a bidirectional local window and the top-K chunks scored from that mask; the other layers use a bidirectional sliding window. Starting from Dream-v0-Base-7B extended to 16K with YaRN, we compare Prefilling-dLLM v2 with bidirectional NSA, DSA, and SWA under the same layout, key budget, and dense initialization, using the same Fast-dLLM decoder. With the YaRN factor scaled to the evaluation length, Prefilling-dLLM v2 leads the other sparse methods on all three RULER tasks from 16K to 128K. Its mean accuracy at 128K is 7.4 points above NSA, the next sparse model, while DSA and SWA remain near zero. At the same length, decoding is 172x faster than with full dense attention.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Prefilling-dLLM v2，通过对扩散语言模型进行继续训练使其利用原生mask token进行路由，在长上下文任务上实现了更优的性能和显著加速。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型在每个去噪步骤中对整个上下文应用双向注意力，导致长上下文下每步计算成本高昂。同时，仅在推理时进行稀疏化会使模型从未在其运行时的稀疏模式下接受训练，造成训练与推理的不匹配。
AI.method: Prefilling-dLLM v2通过继续训练扩散语言模型，使其利用原生mask token进行路由。具体而言，在每个chunk末尾附加一个mask，通过学习的角色偏移将其标记为路由槽；每四层中查询保持双向局部窗口和由该mask评分的top-K chunks，其余层使用双向滑动窗口。
AI.result: 基于Dream-v0-Base-7B并使用YaRN扩展至16K，在相同布局、key预算和密集初始化条件下，Prefilling-dLLM v2在16K至128K的三项RULER任务上均领先NSA、DSA和SWA。在128K处，其平均准确率比次优稀疏模型NSA高7.4分，而DSA和SWA接近零；解码速度比全密集注意力快172倍。
AI.conclusion: 在模型推理时使用的稀疏模式下进行训练对扩散语言模型至关重要。Prefilling-dLLM v2展示了强大的长上下文性能和显著的加速效果，表明利用原生路由机制进行继续训练是扩散模型中稀疏注意力的有效方法。

title: Diff Diffusion: Predicting Edit Paths with Diffusion Models for Efficient Code Editing
summary: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) are appealing for code generation because they can update many tokens in parallel, yet many are optimized for sequence synthesis rather than edit prediction. This setting is poorly matched to modern AI-assisted IDEs, where edit prediction must infer the next code change from recent edits, the current file, and cursor-local context. Such changes are usually sparse and preserve most source tokens, so regenerating a full code segment wastes computation. We propose Diff Diffusion, a diffusion-inspired LLM framework for code editing that predicts edit paths from an original snippet to its revised form. Diff Diffusion represents denoising as structured edit operations, and combines this formulation with multi-stage training and efficient parallel decoding. By focusing computation on changed regions, Diff Diffusion supports accurate low-latency edits and multi-position parallel modification. Across public edit-completion benchmarks, edit-prediction evaluations, and online validation, Diff Diffusion matches or leads autoregressive baselines while delivering 2.78 times faster inference on public edit-completion benchmarks and a 39.0% P50 model-latency reduction in production. This work provides a new modeling perspective for AI applications that require high accuracy and low latency.

AI.motivation: 现有的扩散大语言模型多针对序列生成而非编辑预测优化，而现代AI辅助IDE中的代码编辑通常是稀疏的，重新生成整个代码段会浪费计算资源且带来高延迟。
AI.method: 提出Diff Diffusion框架，将去噪过程表示为从原始代码片段到修订版本的结构化编辑操作，并结合多阶段训练和高效并行解码，将计算集中于更改区域。
AI.result: 在公共编辑补全基准测试和在线验证中，该模型匹配或超越了自回归基线，在公共基准上推理速度提升2.78倍，在生产环境中P50模型延迟降低39.0%。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为需要高精度和低延迟的AI应用提供了新的建模视角，并验证了扩散模型在代码编辑预测任务中的有效性与潜力。

title: PIG: Parallel Inconsistency Guidance for Accelerating Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion language models accelerate generation by decoding multiple masked positions per forward pass. However, accuracy is known to drop when parallel decoding trajectories deviate from their sequential counterparts, which are slow and expensive "oracles" that adhere to the joint distribution of language. In this paper, we propose Parallel Inconsistency Guidance (PIG), a new paradigm that uses a trained auxiliary model to directly estimate the inconsistency between parallel and sequential generation from a single model forward pass. During inference, masked positions are traversed by decreasing confidence, and tokens are added to the parallel decode set one-at-a-time until the total estimated inconsistency between the parallel and sequential generation exceeds a threshold. Surprisingly, it suffices to train a lightweight ~2M parameter auxiliary model on a small mixture drawn from OpenCoder, GSM8K-train, MATH-train, and MBPP-train. For LLaDA-8B Instruct and NemotronDiffusion-3B Instruct, PIG extends the accuracy-TPF frontier on GSM8K, MATH500, MBPP, HumanEval, and MMLU, when compared to the industry standard Fast-dLLM and measures favorably on LLaDA-8B Instruct against DAPD, KLASS, EB-sampler, and other learned unmasking policies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并行不一致性引导（PIG）方法，利用轻量级辅助模型估计并行与顺序解码间的偏差，在扩散语言模型中实现高效的并行解码。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型通过每次前向传播解码多个掩码位置来加速生成，但当并行解码轨迹偏离缓慢且昂贵的顺序生成时，准确率会下降。本文旨在解决此准确率下降问题。
AI.method: 提出PIG范式，训练一个约200万参数的轻量级辅助模型，通过单次前向传播直接估计并行与顺序生成间的不一致性。推理时按置信度递减遍历掩码位置并逐个加入并行解码集，直到估计的不一致性超过阈值。
AI.result: 在GSM8K、MATH500等基准测试中，PIG扩展了LLaDA-8B和NemotronDiffusion-3B模型的准确率-TPF边界，表现优于Fast-dLLM，并与DAPD、KLASS等方法相比具有优势。
AI.conclusion: PIG仅需少量数据和轻量级辅助模型即可有效提升扩散语言模型的并行解码准确率和速度，为未来扩散模型的采样策略提供了新方向。

title: Label Collapse in Diffusion Language Model In-Context Learning
summary: In-context learning (ICL) applies large language models to new tasks by prepending a few labeled demonstrations to a query. Prior work has studied how demonstration ordering affects ICL, but the interaction between label arrangement patterns and model biases has not been systematically examined. We define label collapse as the failure mode in which the model generates query-independent labels, and show that it is architecturally universal at the tested 8-9B scale: five models spanning autoregressive (Llama-3, Qwen3.5) and discrete diffusion (LLaDA, iLLaDA, LLaDA-Instruct) families all exhibit label collapse even under the class-balanced alternating arrangement, with some label word pairs collapsing in virtually every tested condition and others flipping their collapse direction with arrangement. Critically, accuracy alone cannot detect this collapse: models can achieve near-chance accuracy while generating query-independent labels, a score indistinguishable from balanced performance, so the failure can persist undetected in deployment. We measure separation, the log-odds of the two label words at the query position (the quantity that label-bias calibration operates on), as a complementary diagnostic that exposes collapse hidden beneath surface accuracy, together with a measurement protocol that guards label extraction against tokenizer and formatting artifacts. For autoregressive models, collapse persists where the majority-label-bias account does not apply, and arrangement patterns can reverse the collapse direction; for diffusion models, we present a systematic evaluation of ICL failure modes, complementing contemporaneous studies of dLLM context comprehension and demonstration-order sensitivity, and identify open questions about how iterative denoising interacts with label biases.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了上下文学习中普遍存在的“标签坍缩”现象，即模型生成与查询无关的标签，并指出仅靠准确率无法检测此问题。
AI.motivation: 先前研究未系统考察标签排列模式与模型偏差的相互作用，且模型在部署中可能发生仅靠准确率无法检测到的“标签坍缩”（生成与查询无关的标签）。
AI.method: 提出测量“分离度”（即两个标签词在查询位置的对数赔率）作为补充诊断指标，并设计测量协议防止分词器和格式伪影干扰标签提取，评估了8-9B规模的自回归和离散扩散模型。
AI.result: 实验发现标签坍缩在测试的8-9B规模的自回归和离散扩散模型中普遍存在（即使在类别平衡排列下）；部分标签对几乎总会坍缩，部分坍缩方向会随排列模式改变；模型可能在生成与查询无关标签时维持近随机准确率。
AI.conclusion: 仅靠准确率不足以检测标签坍缩，分离度是有效诊断指标；对于自回归模型，排列模式可逆转坍缩方向，而扩散模型迭代去噪与标签偏差的相互作用仍待解答。

title: Where Draft Trees Lose Target Mass: Exit-Guided Speculative Decoding
summary: Tree-based speculative decoding verifies multiple draft continuations in one target-model pass, but finite trees built from draft scores face a fundamental draft-target mismatch. We ask whether better exact verification can increase acceptance on a fixed tree and how target feedback can improve the tree itself. Through a target-flow view, we identify a canonical exit law and prove that one plus target coverage sharply bounds the expected output-block length, including the bonus token, of any exact path verifier. All optimal verifiers share the same exit and bonus-token law, already attained by representative predraw-and-follow and sequential residual verifiers. This yields Tree Exit Verification (TEV), an exact, level-parallel procedure using one exit-node decision and one bonus-token decision. The exit law also identifies missing target probability, providing node-level feedback for Exit-Guided Draft-Tree Training (ExitTrain) on inference-time draft trees. Experiments across dialogue, code, and mathematical reasoning validate fixed-tree equivalence: ExitTrain increases average output-block length by 13%, while TEV reduces verifier-stage latency by 15%, yielding a 14% end-to-end speedup over DDTree. Our results distinguish two opportunities: better draft trees for higher acceptance and more direct verification for lower latency. Code: https://github.com/hsj576/TEV.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了树退出验证（TEV）和退出引导的草稿树训练（ExitTrain），以提高基于树的推测解码的接受率并降低延迟。
AI.motivation: 基于树的推测解码在使用基于草稿分数构建的有限树时，面临草稿与目标模型之间根本的不匹配问题。本文旨在解决如何通过更好的精确验证来提高固定树上的接受率，以及如何利用目标模型的反馈来改进树本身。
AI.method: 本文引入目标流视图来识别规范的退出定律，并证明它界定了任何精确路径验证器的预期输出块长度。这催生了树退出验证（TEV），这是一种精确的、层级并行的程序，包含一次退出节点决策和一次奖励令牌决策。此外，退出定律可识别缺失的目标概率，为退出引导的草稿树训练（ExitTrain）提供节点级反馈。
AI.result: 在对话、代码和数学推理任务上的实验验证了固定树的等效性：ExitTrain将平均输出块长度增加了13%，而TEV将验证器阶段的延迟降低了15%，与DDTree相比实现了14%的端到端加速。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果区分了两个关键机会：构建更好的草稿树以提高接受率，以及采用更直接的验证方法以降低延迟。

title: DominoTree: Conditional Tree-Structured Drafting with Domino for Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates LLM inference by drafting tokens and verifying them in parallel. Block-diffusion drafters such as DFlash model only per-position marginals, and tree methods such as DDTree expand candidate trees from those marginals. The released Domino drafter adds a GRU-based causal correction making each draft token's distribution path-dependent, a structure DDTree's factorized formulation cannot represent. We introduce DominoTree, a training-free best-first draft tree scored by Domino's conditional (non-factorized) correction along each root-to-node path, made practical by restricting the per-node correction to a candidate top-M. We evaluate it on eight benchmarks in a single-stream harness, and in SGLang, where it runs as an out-of-tree plugin against AR, DFlash, EAGLE-3 and Domino under identical flags. DominoTree attains the highest mean accepted length in every serving cell - two model sizes, single-request and concurrent load, context to 32K - and the highest Overall accepted length at every temperature in the research harness (21 of 24 per-dataset cells). A three-arm decomposition holding drafter, budget and verifier fixed separates the gain from applying the correction at all (+10.1% accepted length) from that of recomputing it along each candidate's realized path (+4.7% more), the part this paper adds. Where the round is verify-dominated, throughput follows: up to 7.3x over AR on Qwen3-8B, beating the released Domino decoder at its CUDA-graph best at every temperature, and inside SGLang winning single-request throughput by +12% over Domino on Qwen3-8B. On HELMET long context it beats Domino by +29-36% accepted length and +10-34% throughput at every length and both model sizes. Past a memory-constrained card's admission cap the chain wins goodput, and at our longest context, where prefill dominates, our lead over EAGLE-3 narrows to a tie.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种无需训练的推测解码树构建方法DominoTree，通过利用路径依赖的条件修正显著提升了LLM推理的接受长度和吞吐量。
AI.motivation: 现有的树状推测解码方法（如DDTree）依赖因式分解的边缘分布，无法表示像Domino这种具有路径依赖因果修正的草稿模型结构，限制了推理加速的潜力。
AI.method: 提出DominoTree，一种无需训练的best-first草稿树构建方法。该方法通过沿根到节点的路径评估Domino的条件（非因式分解）修正得分，并将每个节点的修正限制在候选top-M内以保证计算实用性。
AI.result: 在8个基准测试中，DominoTree在所有测试单元内均取得最高平均接受长度，吞吐量最高达自回归的7.3倍。在SGLang和HELMET长上下文基准上，其接受长度和吞吐量均显著优于Domino及EAGLE-3等基线模型，仅在预填充占主导的最长上下文中与EAGLE-3平局。
AI.conclusion: DominoTree成功将非因式分解的条件修正应用于草稿树构建，实现了显著的速度提升，证明了路径依赖建模在推测解码中的重要性。未来可进一步探索在预填充主导场景下的优化。

title: GRAFT: Adaptive DLM-Based Draft Tree Construction with Target-Distilled Edge Scoring
summary: Tree-based speculative decoding raises the mean accepted tokens of standard speculative decoding by verifying multiple draft paths, and existing tree builders typically construct these paths through parent-conditioned expansion, where each child token is generated conditioned on its parent path. This construction is incompatible with diffusion language model (DLM) drafters such as DFlash, which produces all future-position distributions in a single forward pass. DDTree bridges this gap by treating high-probability tokens from each future-position distribution as candidate nodes and selecting edges between consecutive positions under a fixed node budget. However, its edge selection relies on token probability alone without modeling parent--child compatibility, so target-compatible tokens can be attached to wrong parents; moreover, its fixed budget ignores that the throughput-optimal tree size varies with the decoding state. We propose GRAFT, a draft-tree construction framework for DLM-based speculative decoding. GRAFT introduces Target-Distilled Edge Scoring (TDES), which distills parent--child preferences from target-model traces to select target-compatible edges, and State-Aware Budget Allocation (SABA), which sets the per-round tree budget by balancing expected draft gain against verification cost. Across multiple models and tasks, GRAFT achieves $2.13\times$--$6.36\times$ end-to-end speedup over autoregressive decoding while adding less than $0.5$\,ms of overhead per round, approximately $1.4\%$ of the target-model verification latency.

AI.tldr: GRAFT是一个用于扩散语言模型（DLM）推测解码的草稿树构建框架，通过目标蒸馏边缘评分和状态感知预算分配优化了树的构建过程。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于树的推测解码与扩散语言模型（DLM）草稿器不兼容。虽然DDTree试图解决此问题，但其仅依赖token概率的边缘选择忽略了父子兼容性，且固定预算机制无法适应随解码状态变化的最优树大小。
AI.method: 提出GRAFT框架，包含目标蒸馏边缘评分（TDES）和状态感知预算分配（SABA）。TDES从目标模型轨迹中蒸馏父子偏好以选择目标兼容边缘；SABA通过平衡预期草稿增益与验证成本动态设定每轮树预算。
AI.result: 在多种模型和任务中，GRAFT相比自回归解码实现了2.13倍至6.36倍的端到端加速，且每轮额外开销低于0.5毫秒（约占目标模型验证延迟的1.4%）。
AI.conclusion: GRAFT成功解决了DLM草稿器在树构建中的边缘选择和预算分配问题，在极低开销下实现了显著的解码加速，为高效推测解码提供了新的有效方案。

title: Cost-Aware Diffusion Draft Trees for Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates inference by having a lightweight drafter propose tokens verified in parallel by the target language model. Block diffusion drafters such as DFlash generate an entire draft block in one pass, yielding per-position marginals; DDTree uses these to build a candidate tree that maximizes expected acceptance length under a fixed node budget. We observe, however, that acceptance length is non-decreasing in budget: it always favors larger trees regardless of verification cost, offering no principled basis for budget selection. We introduce \textbf{CaDDTree} (Cost-aware Diffusion Draft Tree), a method that directly optimizes token throughput (expected tokens generated per unit time) by jointly selecting the tree structure and node budget. We model draft and verification latencies explicitly, show that the throughput objective decomposes into a per-round one-dimensional search over the budget, and prove that under a convex verification cost the throughput function is \emph{unimodal}, enabling an efficient greedy stopping rule. CaDDTree requires no offline budget search, adapting the budget each round from the current per-position distributions and verification cost. Experiments on Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B across eight benchmarks spanning reasoning, coding, and instruction-following tasks show that \caDDTree{} matches or surpasses DDTree with oracle budget selection on nearly all tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CaDDTree方法，通过显式建模延迟并联合优化树结构与节点预算，直接最大化令牌吞吐量。
AI.motivation: 现有的DDTree方法在固定节点预算下最大化预期接受长度，但该指标随预算非递减，缺乏选择预算的原则性依据，且忽略了验证成本，无法直接优化实际推理吞吐量。
AI.method: CaDDTree显式建模草拟和验证延迟，将令牌吞吐量优化问题分解为每轮的一维预算搜索。在凸验证成本假设下，证明了吞吐量函数是单峰的，从而使用高效的贪婪停止规则联合确定树结构和节点预算。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-4B和Qwen3-8B模型上的八个基准测试中，CaDDTree无需离线预算搜索，在几乎所有任务上均匹配或超越了使用Oracle预算选择的DDTree的性能。
AI.conclusion: CaDDTree提供了一种原则性、自适应的预算选择机制，通过直接优化吞吐量有效提升了推测解码的效率，消除了对手动预算调整的依赖。

title: TAPS: Target-Aware Prefix Tree Selection for Diffusion-Drafted Speculative Decoding
summary: Using a diffusion model for parallel drafting is a promising approach for speculative decoding. By predicting tokens at multiple future positions in a single forward pass, diffusion drafters substantially reduce drafting latency. However, this shifts the bottleneck to verification: verifying a single sequence limits acceptance length, while verifying large draft trees incurs excessive target-model latency. We identify a key mismatch in existing draft-tree methods: existing diffusion-tree methods rank nodes by the marginal probability, ignoring that verification is prefix-conditioned. As a result, they may verify unreachable descendants of rejected prefixes, increasing latency with limited acceptance gains. To address this, we propose TAPS, a target-aware prefix selection method that turns diffusion marginals into path-conditioned acceptance estimates. TAPS then selects a compact prefix-closed subtree under a fixed verification budget, improving the acceptance-cost tradeoff rather than simply expanding the draft tree. Experiments across diverse datasets and model families demonstrate that TAPS achieves up to 7.9x lossless end-to-end speedup over vanilla autoregressive decoding, outperforming state-of-the-art DFlash and DDTree by 1.36x and 1.74x respectively. Our work is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/TAPS-EMNLP2026-53DD

AI.tldr: TAPS提出了一种目标感知的前缀选择方法，通过在固定预算下构建紧凑的前缀闭合子树，有效解决了扩散模型投机解码中的验证瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 使用扩散模型进行并行起草虽能降低起草延迟，但将瓶颈转移至验证阶段。现有方法基于边际概率排序节点，忽略了验证的前缀条件性，导致验证被拒绝前缀的不可达后代，增加延迟且收益有限。
AI.method: 提出TAPS（目标感知前缀选择）方法，将扩散模型的边际概率转化为路径条件接受估计，并在固定验证预算下选择紧凑的前缀闭合子树，以优化接受成本权衡。
AI.result: 实验表明，TAPS相比纯自回归解码实现了高达7.9倍的无损端到端加速，且比最先进的DFlash和DDTree分别快1.36倍和1.74倍。
AI.conclusion: TAPS通过改进验证树的构建策略，有效解决了扩散模型投机解码中的验证瓶颈，显著提升了大模型推理速度。

title: Accelerating Speculative Decoding with Block Diffusion Draft Trees
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive language models by using a lightweight drafter to propose multiple future tokens, which the target model then verifies in parallel. DFlash shows that a block diffusion drafter can generate an entire draft block in a single forward pass and achieve state-of-the-art speculative decoding performance, outperforming strong autoregressive drafters such as EAGLE-3. Vanilla DFlash, however, still verifies only a single drafted trajectory per round, potentially limiting its acceptance length. We introduce DDTree (Diffusion Draft Tree), a method that constructs a draft tree directly from the per-position distributions of a block diffusion drafter. Under a fixed node budget, DDTree uses a simple best-first heap algorithm to select the continuations that are most likely to match the target model according to a surrogate defined by the draft model's output. The resulting tree is verified efficiently in a single target model forward pass using an ancestor-only attention mask. Because DDTree builds on DFlash, a leading draft model for speculative decoding, these gains place DDTree among the leading approaches to speculative decoding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了DDTree方法，通过从块扩散起草器的分布构建草稿树，解决了单轨迹验证限制并提升了推测解码性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的DFlash等方法每轮仅验证单一草稿轨迹，限制了接受长度和整体加速效果。
AI.method: 提出DDTree方法，利用块扩散起草器每位置的分布直接构建草稿树；在固定节点预算下，采用最佳优先堆算法选择最可能匹配目标模型的延续，并使用祖先专属注意力掩码在单次前向传播中完成验证。
AI.result: 基于DFlash的DDTree在推测解码中取得了显著增益，跻身领先的推测解码方法之列。
AI.conclusion: DDTree成功突破了单轨迹验证的瓶颈，为推测解码技术提供了更优的解决方案。

title: Grounding Generative Verification in 3D Content
summary: Recent advances in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) and 3D generation have expanded 3D understanding and synthesis. However, beyond visual fidelity, task-specific correctness grounded in 3D evidence remains a major challenge. We argue that building reliable 3D systems requires not only stronger generation and reasoning, but also verification feedback that identifies unmet requirements and explains their violations, allowing systems to reflect on and refine their outputs. Such feedback must integrate multi-view observations and distinguish genuine inconsistencies from projection-dependent appearances. We make three contributions. First, we introduce 3DVerifierBench, a benchmark spanning 10 tasks that evaluates decisions, rejection explanations, and responses to controlled changes in specifications and candidates. A human study reveals a 21.6 percentage-point gap between humans and the strongest tested model, GPT-6 Astra, while explanation-aware analysis exposes weaknesses in rejection reliability. Second, we analyze verification across fine-grained factual categories, exposing errors in values and target binding. We develop a scalable pipeline combining multi-view fact extraction, controlled 3D editing, and native annotations to produce 14,126 training examples with contradiction explanations and linked counterfactuals. Third, we examine how verification could support 3D generation through candidate selection and recursive refinement. In human-labeled sixteen-candidate pools, oracle selection improves complete factual success from 26.7% to 90.0%. In a separate eight-input study, human-guided recursive refinement satisfies all seven requirements for every input, compared with three under parallel Oracle@8. Together, our benchmark, analysis, and data pipeline establish a foundation for models to reflect on 3D content through reliable verification feedback.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了3DVerifierBench基准和数据流水线，用于评估和改进3D内容验证反馈，使模型能够识别并解释3D生成中未满足的需求。
AI.motivation: 尽管多模态大语言模型和3D生成技术有所进展，但基于3D证据的任务特定正确性仍是主要挑战，需要验证反馈来识别未满足的需求并解释违规原因，使系统能够反思和改进输出。
AI.method: 论文提出三个贡献：一是引入3DVerifierBench基准，覆盖10个任务评估决策、拒绝解释及对规格和候选变更的响应；二是开发可扩展流水线，结合多视角事实提取、可控3D编辑和原生标注，生成14,126个带矛盾解释和关联反事实的训练样本；三是研究验证如何通过候选选择和递归精炼支持3D生成。
AI.result: 人类研究显示最强模型GPT-6 Astra与人类间存在21.6个百分点的差距；在16候选池中，oracle选择将完整事实成功率从26.7%提升至90.0%；在8输入研究中，人类引导的递归精炼满足每个输入的所有7项需求，而并行Oracle@8仅满足3项。
AI.conclusion: 该基准、分析和数据流水线为模型通过可靠验证反馈反思3D内容奠定了基础，表明验证反馈可显著提升3D生成的任务特定正确性。

title: SUPRA-TEX: 3D Generation with Super-Aligned Texture
summary: Single image 3D generation aims to dress a given 3D mesh with relightable materials while faithfully preserving the visual details of a reference image. Existing methods either introduce artifacts when fusing inconsistent multi-view predictions or struggle to preserve fine details through implicit image-feature conditioning. To resolve these challenges, we introduce SUPRA-Tex, built on the principle of decoupling visible-material estimation, surface alignment, and observation-guided 3D completion. This division of labor allows the 3D generator, trained on limited 3D data, to focus its capacity on preserving visible evidence and completing unobserved surfaces. Specifically, we first train an MLLM-based image editing model to predict lighting-separated PBR maps in the reference view. We then project these maps onto the visible surface and encode them with the pretrained material VAE encoder into native observation latents that share the generation target's latent space. An interleaved flow transformer holds these latents as fixed, read-only anchors while alternating unobserved-region and full-surface updates to generate complete material latents. This design achieves super-alignment with the reference, delivering What You See Is What You Get fidelity on visible regions and coherent completion on unobserved surfaces. Trained solely on public datasets, SUPRA-Tex achieves SOTA performance in both geometry-conditioned texturing and end-to-end asset generation, matching or even exceeding leading commercial systems on in-the-wild images. Project page: https://supra-3d.github.io/supratex/

AI.tldr: 本文提出SUPRA-Tex，通过解耦可见材质估计、表面对齐与观察引导的3D补全，实现高保真单图3D材质生成。
AI.motivation: 现有的单图3D生成方法在融合不一致的多视角预测时易产生伪影，或在隐式图像特征条件下难以保留精细细节，本文旨在解决这些伪影和细节丢失问题。
AI.method: SUPRA-Tex首先训练基于MLLM的图像编辑模型预测参考视角的光照分离PBR贴图；接着将其投影至可见表面并编码为与生成目标共享潜空间的原生观测潜变量；最后，交错流变换器将这些潜变量作为只读锚点，交替更新未观测区域和全表面以生成完整材质潜变量。
AI.result: 该方法在可见区域实现了“所见即所得”的超对齐保真度，并在未观测表面实现连贯补全。仅使用公开数据集训练，该方法在几何条件纹理和端到端资产生成上均达到SOTA，在野外图像上匹敌甚至超越领先商业系统。
AI.conclusion: SUPRA-Tex通过解耦生成流程并利用观测潜变量锚点，成功实现了高保真且可重新打光的单图3D资产生成，其仅依赖公开数据即媲美商业系统的表现具有重要的实践意义。

title: CART: Compatible Routing for Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) achieve strong performance through instruction tuning, yet real-world applications often require them to continually acquire new capabilities from sequential tasks, i.e., Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning (MCIT). In typical MLLMs, a projector is employed to align visual representations with the language model. However, existing methods primarily protect the language model from forgetting while continuously updating the projector across tasks. Such asymmetric adaptation can cause substantial representation drift in the projector, increasing the mismatch between the projector and language model and consequently exacerbating catastrophic forgetting. To address this issue, we propose Compatible Routing (CART), which explicitly coordinates the adaptation of the projector and language model. Specifically, CART maintains task-specific experts for both modules and combines them through weighted mixtures. CART jointly infers their weights by considering both expert relevance and cross-module compatibility, thereby promoting coordinated adaptation between the two modules. To further control model growth, we introduce relevance-guided expert consolidation, which merges experts exhibiting similar relevance profiles across samples within each module. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CART achieves state-of-the-art performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出兼容路由方法（CART），通过协调投影器与语言模型的适配，缓解多模态持续指令调优中的灾难性遗忘问题。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM在多模态持续指令调优中存在非对称适配问题：持续更新投影器而保护语言模型，导致投影器表示漂移并加剧与语言模型的不匹配，从而加剧灾难性遗忘。
AI.method: 提出兼容路由（CART），为投影器和语言模型分别维护任务特定专家并通过加权混合组合，联合推断权重时同时考虑专家相关性与跨模块兼容性；并引入相关性引导的专家合并机制以控制模型增长。
AI.result: 大量实验表明CART在多模态持续指令调优任务上取得了当前最优性能。
AI.conclusion: CART通过显式协调投影器与语言模型的自适应过程，有效缓解了灾难性遗忘，并在控制模型规模的同时实现了领先性能。

title: When Reasoning Is Not Enough: Proactive Inquiry for Cross-Modal Safety in Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can act unsafely when individually benign images and texts are interpreted jointly. Beyond implicit reasoning risk, where reasoning drifts toward harm, we identify intent-level risk, where cross-modal ambiguity silently commits the model to a hazardous premise that path-level optimization alone cannot correct. We propose SAFE-PRO, which uses a Risk-Conditioned Uncertainty (RCU) signal, combining predictive entropy with a learned cross-modal risk score, to decide when to ask safety-grounded clarifying questions and where to apply path optimization, under a reward that prioritizes safety and penalizes over-refusal. We also build SSUI-Dialog, a multimodal multi-turn dataset with dual-intent supervision, and theoretically analyze gradient variance and unsafe-completion risk under RCU. Across seven benchmarks and two base MLLMs, SAFE-PRO consistently improves safety over SRPO, roughly halves its over-refusal, and surpasses GPT-4o and Claude-3.5-Sonnet in average single-turn safety.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SAFE-PRO框架，通过风险条件不确定性信号动态引导多模态大语言模型进行安全澄清或路径优化，有效缓解意图级风险并降低过度拒绝。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型在联合解释单一无害的图文时可能产生不安全行为。除了推理偏向伤害的隐式推理风险外，跨模态歧义会暗中使模型承诺危险前提，产生路径级优化无法纠正的意图级风险。
AI.method: 提出SAFE-PRO，结合预测熵与跨模态风险分数生成风险条件不确定性（RCU）信号，以此决定何时提出基于安全的澄清问题及何处应用路径优化，并采用优先安全、惩罚过度拒绝的奖励机制。同时构建了SSUI-Dialog数据集并进行了相关理论分析。
AI.result: 在七个基准和两个基础模型上，SAFE-PRO的安全性持续优于SRPO，过度拒绝率降低近一半，且平均单轮安全性超越GPT-4o和Claude-3.5-Sonnet。
AI.conclusion: SAFE-PRO通过引入RCU信号有效解决了多模态模型中的意图级风险问题，在提升安全性的同时显著减少了过度拒绝现象，表现优于当前顶尖模型。

title: Seeing is Believing: Benchmarking and Mitigating the Interference of Language Priors on Visual Perception in MLLMs
summary: Language priors in MLLMs can override visual evidence, impairing visual perception. Existing benchmarks assume shared priors across models and rely solely on accuracy. However, cross-model prior agreement falls below 80%, and over 15% of items can be answered correctly without any image, causing accuracy to overestimate prior resistance. To address these limitations, we introduce ViSiP-Bench, a benchmark grounded in rare-but-real scenarios across six prior categories, with a model-aware dynamic prior induction protocol and three metrics that more precisely and continuously measure prior resistance than accuracy alone. Evaluating 24 models reveals that prior adherence is pervasive, does not improve with scale, and larger models tend to either strongly override their priors or firmly adhere to them. We therefore propose MAPS, which identifies each model's strongest priors and fine-tunes on factually grounded knowledge to soften excessive prior reliance without disrupting general capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了ViSiP-Bench基准和MAPS微调方法，以更精确地评估和缓解多模态大语言模型中语言先验对视觉证据的干扰。
AI.motivation: 现有基准假设模型间共享语言先验且仅依赖准确率进行评估，但由于跨模型先验一致性低于80%且超过15%的问题无需图像即可答对，导致准确率高估了模型的先验抵抗力。
AI.method: 提出了基于罕见但真实场景的ViSiP-Bench基准，包含模型感知的动态先验诱导协议和三种新指标；并提出了MAPS方法，通过识别模型最强先验并在基于事实的知识上进行微调来减弱过度先验依赖。
AI.result: 对24个模型的评估表明，先验依赖现象普遍存在，且不随模型规模增大而改善；较大的模型往往要么强烈推翻先验，要么坚定遵循先验。
AI.conclusion: MAPS方法能够在不破坏模型通用能力的前提下有效软化过度的先验依赖，为提升多模态大语言模型的视觉感知能力提供了有效途径。

title: Beyond Generation: Using Multimodal LLMs as Detectors of LLM-Generated Deepfake Facial Images
summary: As image generation models become increasingly capable of producing highly realistic content, traditional forensic techniques are struggling to keep up. This paper investigates whether MLLMs can instead be used as a form of forensic analysis by identifying synthetic media. Specifically, the study aims to determine whether these models detect fake images by recognising physical inconsistencies, or whether they rely on digital artefacts such as embedded watermarks.Six MLLMs: GPT-4o, GPT-5, GPT-5.2, Gemini 2.5, Gemini 3, and Seed 1.6, are benchmarked using a dataset of 400 images. Fifty images are authentic photographs, while the remaining 350 are generated using seven leading image models: Gemini 3, Gemini 2.5, Flux.2 Pro, GPT-Image-1, GPT-Image-1.5, Seedream 4.0, and Seedream 4.5. The evaluation is structured in three stages: single-image classification, pairwise comparison, and a focused "self-detection" experiment on Gemini. Several MLLMs achieved a high detection accuracy, with GPT-5.2 reaching a peak of 97.9% in the pairwise experiment, against specific generators and an overall mean pairwise accuracy of 82.5% by identifying structural or physical inconsistencies within images. However, results from the self-detection experiment indicate that the presence of invisible SynthID watermarks leads to a 10% reduction in Gemini's detection accuracy compared to the clean control group. One possible explanation is that SynthID embedding reduces some of the visible artefacts the models rely on for detection.These results imply that MLLMs can detect structural artefacts without relying on watermarks, but performance varies substantially across model generations. The findings from comparison C5 also suggest that SynthID embedding may suppress some of the structural artefacts used during detection.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）能否通过识别物理不一致性或数字伪影来进行合成图像取证，发现MLLMs能有效检测结构性伪影，但水印嵌入可能降低检测准确率。
AI.motivation: 随着图像生成模型生成高度逼真内容的能力增强，传统取证技术难以跟上步伐，因此需要探索MLLMs在检测合成媒体方面的潜力和机制。
AI.method: 评估了六个MLLMs（GPT-4o, GPT-5, GPT-5.2, Gemini 2.5, Gemini 3, Seed 1.6）在包含400张真实和生成图像的数据集上的表现。评估分为三个阶段：单图分类、成对比较和针对Gemini的“自我检测”实验。
AI.result: GPT-5.2在成对实验中达到97.9%的检测准确率，整体平均成对准确率为82.5%，主要通过识别结构和物理不一致性。然而，在自我检测实验中，不可见的SynthID水印导致Gemini的检测准确率下降了10%，可能是因为SynthID嵌入减少了模型依赖的可见伪影。
AI.conclusion: MLLMs能够在不依赖水印的情况下检测结构性伪影，但不同模型代际间的表现差异很大。研究还表明，SynthID嵌入可能会抑制检测过程中使用的某些结构性伪影。

title: Full-Duplex Interaction with Speech, Expressions and Gestures
summary: Human face-to-face conversation requires coordinating speech, gestures and expressions across both speaking and listening. We present ELLSA 2, an end-to-end full-duplex dialogue model that jointly optimizes speech interaction and streaming gesture-expression generation. An autoregressive, chunk-wise synthesizer combines pretrained acoustic features with distinct listening and speaking hidden states from the dialogue backbone and speech synthesizer, enabling continuous non-verbal generation even when the model is verbally silent. To translate dialogue understanding into vivid semantic gestures, we introduce contextual semantic calls and template guidance, separating whether to invoke an available semantic gesture from how to realize it. We also establish a curated data and evaluation pipeline for dialog-aware co-speech gesture generation and investigate reference-based multimodal large language models (MLLMs) as automatic judges. Experiments show that ELLSA 2 remains highly competitive with open-source full-duplex speech interaction models and outperforms cascaded baselines across dialog-aware gesture and expression metrics. Semantic template guidance further significantly improves semantic gesture quality. Strong system-level correlations with human judgments support these reference-based scores as useful preliminary metrics for full-duplex and semantic gesture assessment. Together, these results advance dialogue modeling from spoken responses toward coordinated multimodal interaction.

AI.tldr: ELLSA 2是一种端到端全双工对话模型，能够联合优化语音交互和流式手势表情生成，实现协调的多模态对话交互。
AI.motivation: 人类面对面对话需要在说话和倾听时协调语音、手势和表情，但现有对话模型主要关注语音响应，缺乏协调的多模态交互能力。
AI.method: 采用自回归分块合成器，结合预训练声学特征与对话骨干网络和语音合成器中独特的倾听和说话隐藏状态；引入上下文语义调用和模板指导，分离语义手势的调用决策与实现方式；建立专门的数据和评估管道，并探索基于参考的多模态大语言模型作为自动评估器。
AI.result: ELLSA 2在与开源全双工语音交互模型的比较中保持高度竞争力，在对话感知的手势和表情指标上优于级联基线；语义模板指导显著提高了语义手势质量；与人类判断的强系统级相关性支持这些基于参考的分数作为有用的初步评估指标。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果将对话建模从单纯的语音响应推进到协调的多模态交互，为全双工对话中的手势和表情生成提供了新的技术路径和评估方法。

title: GeoThinker-$F$: Endogenous Predictive World Representations for Fast Spatial Intelligence
summary: Existing geometry-aware Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) increasingly rely on external 3D encoders to provide structural priors, but executing these additional encoder paths at inference introduces substantial latency and computational overhead. We propose GeoThinker-$F$, an efficient framework that internalizes spatiotemporal perception by transforming causal MLLM hidden states into predictive latent world representations. Our key insight is that intermediate semantic representations contain sufficient information to predict useful representations of current geometry and future semantics, without requiring an exact reproduction of features from a dedicated 3D encoder. To realize this idea, GeoThinker-$F$ adopts a decoupled two-stage training strategy. In the first stage, the MLLM backbone is frozen while lightweight Latent Frame Prediction (LFP) heads learn from an offline 3D geometry expert and next-frame semantic targets. In the second stage, the external expert is removed, and the model is jointly optimized to generate and selectively integrate its self-predicted priors through a specialized Spatial-Grounded Temporal (SGT) Fusion module. Extensive evaluations show that GeoThinker-$F$ eliminates runtime dependence on external 3D geometry encoders while maintaining competitive performance across diverse spatial intelligence benchmarks. It achieves up to a $3.6\times$ inference speedup, reducing latency from $1.45\,\mathrm{s}$ to $0.40\,\mathrm{s}$ while retaining strong spatial reasoning performance.

AI.tldr: 提出GeoThinker-F框架，通过将3D几何感知内化到MLLM隐藏状态中，消除推理时对外部3D编码器的依赖，实现3.6倍推理加速且保持空间推理性能。
AI.motivation: 现有几何感知多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在推理时依赖外部3D编码器获取结构先验，导致显著的延迟和计算开销。
AI.method: 提出GeoThinker-F框架，采用两阶段解耦训练策略：第一阶段冻结MLLM主干，利用离线3D专家训练轻量级潜在帧预测（LFP）头；第二阶段移除外部专家，通过时空接地（SGT）融合模块联合优化模型以生成并选择性整合自预测先验。
AI.result: 该方法在多种空间智能基准测试中保持有竞争力的性能，消除了运行时对外部3D几何编码器的依赖，实现了高达3.6倍的推理加速（延迟从1.45秒降至0.40秒）。
AI.conclusion: GeoThinker-F在不牺牲空间推理能力的前提下，成功通过内部化几何感知大幅提升了MLLM的推理效率，为高效的空间智能模型提供了新方向。

title: Beyond Static Cues: Unified Dynamic Detection of MLLM Backdoors via Dual-Flow Trajectory Analysis
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are increasingly deployed in safety-critical domains, yet their susceptibility to backdoor attacks remains a formidable challenge. While existing defenses have evolved from visual-centric patch cues to unsupervised internal attention statistics, they are fundamentally constrained by a reliance on static snapshots and attack-specific heuristics. Given the intricate interplay between dual modalities, the vast design space for multimodal triggers allows diverse threats, such as textual injections, sub-perceptual noises, and coordinated cross-modal triggers, to easily circumvent such rigid priors, particularly when attack types are unknown in real-world applications. In this paper, we rethink backdoor detection by shifting the diagnostic paradigm from static observations to dynamic output evolution. We observe that a successful attack inevitably hijacks the model's decoding trajectory, skewing internal modal contributions during generation while maintaining an abnormal output invariance despite input perturbations. To capture this behavior, we propose EVO-Detect, a unified detection framework that monitors the dynamic evolution of internal signals during early decoding steps through two complementary channels: Attention Flow and Logits Flow. The attention branch measures how image-text attention allocation evolves during early generation, whereas the logits branch quantifies the sensitivity of the output distribution to modal perturbations through interventional ablations. We then convert these trajectories into compact sample-level metrics and normalize them against negative-control signatures so that natural perturbations are less likely to be mistaken for backdoor evidence. Extensive evaluations show that our approach substantially outperforms state-of-the-art baselines such as BYE and TCAP across diverse attack families.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了EVO-Detect框架，通过监测多模态大语言模型解码过程中内部信号的动态演化来检测后门攻击。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型易受后门攻击，而现有防御方法依赖静态观察和特定攻击的启发式规则，难以应对未知类型的多样化多模态触发器。
AI.method: 提出EVO-Detect框架，通过注意力流监测早期生成中图文注意力分配的演化，通过逻辑流量化输出分布对模态扰动的敏感性，并将这些轨迹转化为样本级指标与负控特征进行对比。
AI.result: 广泛的评估表明，该方法在多种攻击家族中显著优于BYE和TCAP等最先进的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 将后门检测范式从静态观察转向动态输出演化是有效且必要的，能更好地应对复杂未知的多模态后门威胁。

title: VisualWorldBench: A Fine-Grained Multi-Task Benchmark for Evaluating Visual World Knowledge in MLLMs
summary: Visual world knowledge is a core capability of multimodal large language models (MLLMs), underpinning knowledge-intensive visual question answering and fine-grained visual reasoning. However, existing benchmarks remain limited in two key respects. First, their category coverage is narrow: most benchmarks span only a small number of categories across a few domains, falling far short of the open-ended scale of real-world visual entities. Second, their task construction is often insufficiently rigorous: models can answer correctly using coarse-grained cues, vague associations, or elimination strategies without truly mastering precise concepts, making it difficult to accurately assess their knowledge of fine-grained entities. We introduce VisualWorldBench, a taxonomy-grounded multi-task benchmark built on a hierarchical taxonomy of 21,291 leaf-node classes across 8 visual domains, with 32,541 evaluation instances whose ground-truth labels cover 15,479 categories across four complementary tasks: closed-set recognition, contrastive selection, precise localization, and open-world naming, covering different directions of knowledge retrieval and varying degrees of answer openness to comprehensively evaluate visual world knowledge. Most questions are constructed from taxonomically proximate categories, forcing precise discrimination among fine-grained entities. Experiments reveal that the strongest closed-source model achieves only 80.4% average accuracy, exposing capability gaps hidden under conventional benchmarks. We further construct VisualWorldBench-50K, a training resource covering 50K+ categories. Fine-tuning on VisualWorldBench-50K yields over 21 percentage points improvement on VisualWorldBench, with consistent transfer to public fine-grained recognition and visual knowledge benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了基于分类学的多任务基准VisualWorldBench，用于全面评估多模态大语言模型的细粒度视觉世界知识，揭示了现有模型隐藏的能力缺陷，并提出训练资源以显著提升模型性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的视觉基准测试存在类别覆盖面窄和任务构建不严谨的问题，模型可通过粗粒度线索、模糊关联或排除策略答题，难以准确评估其对细粒度实体的掌握程度。
AI.method: 构建了基于21,291个叶节点类别层级分类法的多任务基准VisualWorldBench，包含闭集识别、对比选择、精确定位和开放世界命名四项任务，且问题多由分类相近的类别构成以强制精细辨别；同时构建了覆盖5万+类别的训练资源VisualWorldBench-50K。
AI.result: 最强闭源模型在该基准上的平均准确率仅为80.4%；使用VisualWorldBench-50K进行微调后，模型在VisualWorldBench上的准确率提升了21个百分点以上，并在其他公共基准上表现出良好的迁移效果。
AI.conclusion: VisualWorldBench有效暴露了多模态大模型在细粒度视觉知识上的不足，而针对性的大规模微调能显著提升其视觉世界知识及泛化能力。
